a line extending from near Heartwell to near Hildreth to near Ragan.
Movement was southeast at 40 mph.

HAZARD...Wind gusts of 50 to 55 mph and pea size hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Gusty winds could knock down tree limbs and blow around
unsecured objects. Minor hail damage to vegetation is
possible.

Strong thunderstorms will be near...
Kenesaw, Hildreth, Upland, and Norman around 1030 PM CDT.
Holstein around 1035 PM CDT.
Campbell and Roseland around 1040 PM CDT.
Bladen around 1045 PM CDT.

Other locations in the path of these storms include Ayr, Franklin,
Blue Hill, Riverton, Cowles, Inavale and Rosemont.
